NOTIFICATION

ENHANCEMENT IN INSTITUTE FELLOWSHIP FOR FULL-TIME PhD SCHOLARS

We are pleased to announce the enhancement in the Institute Fellowship and Annual Contingency Grant given to Full-Time PhD scholars of BITS Pilani (Indian campuses only) as per the table below.

1. Students admitted to the PhD programme with a Higher Degree of BITS Pilani or its equivalent: present fellowship ₹31,000; revised fellowship ₹37,000 with effect from 01 July 2023.

2. Students admitted with an Integrated First Degree of BITS Pilani or its equivalent: present fellowship ₹28,000; revised fellowship ₹34,000 with effect from 01 July 2023.

3. Students admitted with an Integrated First Degree of BITS Pilani or its equivalent, on successful completion of coursework from the semester following the one in which the coursework is completed: present fellowship ₹31,000; revised fellowship ₹37,000 with effect from 01 July 2023.

4. After completion of 2 years and approval of the research proposal, increased fellowship based on assessment and recommendation by a campus-level committee constituted by Directors in respective campuses: present fellowship ₹33,000 or ₹35,000; revised fellowship ₹40,000 or ₹42,000 with effect from 01 July 2023.

In addition to the above, the following points may please be noted:

a) The Institute Fellowship may be provided up to a maximum period of five years from the date of admission to the PhD programme or until the date of PhD Viva-Voce examination, whichever is earlier.

b) The Annual Contingency Grant that currently stands at Rs. 10,000 per annum is enhanced to Rs. 20,000 per annum.

c) The above revision is applicable to current PhD scholars who are yet to submit their PhD thesis and to all new scholars.
